name: Donchian ensemble 1d + vol target
change: Same rules; the registry payload now also carries max_hold and the volatility-target parameters, so the run rebuilds exactly.
label: 1d_ens5_vt
hypothesis: The ensemble removed the parameter choice but its Sharpe is only ~0.55, and the t-stat of 1.44 needs ~1.16 to clear the HLZ hurdle. The ensemble variance is predictable even though its mean is not: sizing each trade by target_vol divided by the realised volatility of the previous 30 days raises the Sharpe without changing the sign of any trade. Prediction: PF stays near its unscaled value while the daily Sharpe rises and the drawdown does not deepen. If the Sharpe does not move, the strategy variance is not predictable and volatility targeting adds nothing; that would be a clean falsification.

portfolio.rationale: The five lengths are exactly those in the registry for BTC-TREND-1D (10, 20, 40, 55, 100). All five are included, including the ones that lost: picking the winners out of the set would turn the ensemble back into a selection. Equal weights were fixed before running, not fitted. Risk per trade stays at 0.5% of equity for the whole portfolio, so each component carries 0.1%.

failure_modes: si solo una longitud tenía edge, promediar cinco lo diluye y el ensemble rinde menos que el mejor componente
los cinco componentes abren en la misma ruptura en tendencias sostenidas: la diversificación es menor de lo que sugiere el número de componentes
el t-stat del flujo agregado sobreestima la potencia porque los trades de componentes distintos están correlacionados
gap de liquidación (2025-10-10): los cinco stops se ejecutan a la vez en el mismo hueco
